---
title: "Forecast analysis"
---

```{r}
source("R/weather.R")
source("R/dashboard.R")
snapshot <- read_dashboard_snapshot()
now <- dashboard_now(snapshot)
hourly <- dashboard_hourly(hourly_frame(snapshot$payload, snapshot$timezone), now)
daily <- dashboard_daily(snapshot)
hourly$score <- outdoor_score(hourly)
```

`r dashboard_freshness(snapshot)`

Scroll charts and tables horizontally on smaller screens.

## Outdoor conditions

The score favours temperatures around 20°C, lower rain risk and lighter winds. It is an aid to planning, not a weather warning. This chart covers remaining forecast hours in the next 48 hours.

::: {.chart-scroll tabindex="0" role="region" aria-label="Scrollable forecast chart"}
```{r}
#| results: asis
#| fig-alt: "Outdoor scores over the next 48 forecast hours, in Copenhagen local time."
library(ggplot2)
if (!nrow(hourly) || !any(is.finite(hourly$score))) {
  cat("Outdoor scores are unavailable for the next 48 hours.\n")
} else {
  print(ggplot(hourly, aes(time, score)) +
    geom_area(fill = "#22d3ee", alpha = .28) + geom_line(colour = "#67e8f9", linewidth = 1) +
    scale_x_datetime(date_labels = "%a\n%H:%M", date_breaks = "12 hours", timezone = snapshot$timezone) +
    ylim(0, 100) + labs(x = "Copenhagen time", y = "Outdoor score") + dashboard_chart_theme())
}
```
:::

## Seven-day outlook

::: {.table-scroll tabindex="0" role="region" aria-label="Scrollable daily forecast table"}
```{r}
#| results: asis
if (!nrow(daily)) {
  cat("No daily forecast is available from today.\n")
} else {
  display <- daily
  display$sunrise <- format(daily$sunrise, "%H:%M", tz = snapshot$timezone)
  display$sunset <- format(daily$sunset, "%H:%M", tz = snapshot$timezone)
  for (column in c("min_temp", "max_temp", "pop", "wind_speed")) {
    display[[column]] <- vapply(daily[[column]], dashboard_number, character(1), pattern = "%.1f")
  }
  print(knitr::kable(display,
    col.names = c("Date", "Sunrise", "Sunset", "Low °C", "High °C", "Rain %", "Wind m/s", "Conditions")))
}
```
:::

## Remaining hourly weather today

Each tile shows its value. Colour compares values within each row; rows use different units.

::: {.chart-scroll .heatmap-scroll tabindex="0" role="region" aria-label="Scrollable hourly weather heatmap"}
```{r}
#| results: asis
#| fig-height: 4.5
#| fig-alt: "Remaining daytime hourly weather today. Tile labels show values and units; colour compares values within each row."
heat_long <- dashboard_heatmap_data(hourly, now, snapshot$timezone)
if (!nrow(heat_long)) {
  cat("No remaining hourly forecast is available for today between 07:00 and 22:00 (Europe/Copenhagen).\n")
} else {
  heat_long$relative <- ave(heat_long$value, heat_long$variable, FUN = function(values) {
    valid <- is.finite(values)
    result <- rep(NA_real_, length(values))
    if (any(valid)) {
      span <- range(values[valid])
      result[valid] <- if (diff(span) == 0) .5 else (values[valid] - span[1]) / diff(span)
    }
    result
  })
  heat_long$label <- vapply(heat_long$value, dashboard_number, character(1), pattern = "%.1f")
  heat_long$label[!is.finite(heat_long$value)] <- "—"
  print(ggplot(heat_long, aes(hour_label, variable, fill = relative)) +
    geom_tile(colour = "#0b1220", linewidth = .4) +
    geom_text(aes(label = label, colour = relative >= .5), size = 3) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "#e6edf8", "TRUE" = "#090d16"), na.value = "#e6edf8", guide = "none") +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "#102a43", high = "#67e8f9", limits = c(0, 1),
                        breaks = c(0, 1), labels = c("Lower", "Higher"), na.value = "#263449") +
    labs(x = "Copenhagen time", y = NULL, fill = "Within each row") +
    dashboard_chart_theme() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)))
}
```
:::
